fusions.name: Rehearsed Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge that reaches up to 3 tiles. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Textbook Impalement
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Economy of Motion
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
